scores.evidence: No hard failures in metrics.json: overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block and broken-image errors, and no textOnlyScreens. At 390 px both code blocks fit without wrapping: s2-code in pages/mobile-jp-05/06.png, and p1-model lines 1-16 in pages/mobile-jp-20.png with the highlighted flag lines readable. Answer options made of chips stay whole (check-quiz e3 in pages/mobile-jp-25.png), and the definitions blocks stack cleanly (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, pages/mobile-jp-12/13.png).

Plain text is broken up by headings, definitions, lists, a callout, a step list or a quiz about every one or two screens. desktop-jp median is 37 chars per line (target 30-40), but the max is 51. The longest plain run is section 3 (s3-mode plus the 5-item s3-table) in pages/mobile-jp-10/11.png, and each item there starts with a code chip.

The whole page is in Japanese (lang ja, contentLocale jp, no locale fallback), and English terms appear only as glosses in parentheses. Contrast is good on the dark code blocks, the pitfall callout and the expect boxes. The 1-4 key hints and Enter to answer are visible on desktop, and no control is hidden under the bottom bar on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-31.png).

niceToHave: p1-checklist: the flags in the checklist labels (--bare, --permission-mode dontAsk, Bash(npm test *)) show as plain bold text, not code, because checklist labels are plain text (pages/mobile-jp-19.png, pages/desktop-jp-13.png). If clarity matters more, shorten the labels to name the purpose (for example 「--bare（フックを読まない）」) or accept this as reader behaviour.

s2-steps ex-feature: inside the expect box, the inline code (.claude/worktrees/, worktree-feature-a, worktree-bugfix-b) has almost the same background as the box, so the chips are hard to tell apart (pages/mobile-jp-07.png). reader: give inline code inside expect boxes a separate background.

reader: the glossary side panel lists each term twice, the definitions-block form (ワークツリー（worktree）) and the glossary form (ワークツリー), for example in pages/desktop-jp-04.png. Merge entries that share a term.
reader: the end banner says this is the course's last lesson because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-31.png, pages/desktop-jp-21.png). This is a known draft-preview artifact.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000px, and 13 failed /api/ requests are environment noise, not lesson defects.
summary: I found nothing a learner would struggle with on either mobile or desktop: no hard failures, no text-only screens, and both code blocks fit at 390 px without awkward wrapping. No personal data appears on any screen. The remaining notes are optional: the flags in the checklist show as plain text, and a few things are reader behaviour.
